description_en: Ayuguthi Sataḥ was probably first established in the early 18th century CE, but is said to have originally been built under the order of the sister of a Malla king of Patan. She commissioned the monument after the death of her brother and founded aguṭhīin his memory. The Sataḥ has carved windows as well as exceptionalkalaśacolumns and delicately carved struts depicting Viṣṇu, Bhairava or Śiva. The historical inscription is said to have been stolen in 2000.In the 1990s the building was in a dilapidated state and its ruins were removed by bulldozers in 1999. The Sataḥ was nationalised due to the neglect of its previous owner to maintain this historically valuable site. It was then renovated. Emergency repairs had already taken place in 1992 under Sr Eduard Sekler and the KVPT had then also indicated the need for further repairs, developing a first plan and outlining the damage in 1994. A court had ordered the repair of the monument in 1993, though this request was apparently ignored. Finally, the government intervened under the Ancient Monuments Act section 4.11 and acquired the structure using the Land Acquisition Act. The owner filed an appeal against this order in 1996 and the case was delayed for months, while the building continued to fall apart. The majority of the historical materials became rotten due to monsoon rains, and it took until 1999 for the site to be removed and then rebuilt. In 2001, it was rebuilt by the KVPT with the support of the DOA. Some of the historical carved materials were used for this (see KVPT Final Report 2002; a detailed chronology of the restoration can be found on p. 11).
description_ne: अयुगुथि सतः संभवतः अठारौँ शताब्दीको सुरुमा बनेको थियो । पाटनका कुनै मल्ल राजाकी बहिनीको आज्ञा अनुसार यो सतः बनाइएको हो भनेर स्थानीयहरू बताउँछन् । उनले भाइको मृत्युपछि भाइको संझनामा यो सतः बनाएर यसको संचालनको लागि गुठी पनि राखेकी थिइन् । यस सतःका काष्ठस्तम्भहरूमा कलशाकार बुट्टा कुँदिएका छन् र टुँडालहरूमा विष्णु, भैरव र शिवका मूर्तिहरू कुँदिएका छन् । स्थानीयले बताए अनुसार सतःमा रहेको ऐतिहासिक शिलालेख सन् २००० मा चोरी भयो । सन् १९९० मा सतः भवन भत्कियो, तर यसको भग्नावशेष त्यहाँबाट १९९९ मा मात्र हटाइयो । यो भवनलाई पूर्ण ध्वस्त हुन छाडिदिने यसका तत्कालीन हकदारबाट हक खोसी यसको राष्ट्रीयकरण गरेपछि यसको पुनर्निर्माण गरियो । सतःको आपतकालीन जीर्णोद्धार १९९२ मा एडुवार्ड सेक्लर र केभिपिटिद्वारा गरिएको थियो र पुनर्निर्माणको प्रारम्भिक योजना १९९४ मा बनाइएको थियो । अदालतले यसको पुनर्निर्माण गर्न सन् १९९३ मा आदेश दिएको थियो तर सो आदेशको पालन गरिएन । ऐतिहासिक सम्पदा ऐनको धारा ११.१ अनुसार सरकारले जग्गा अधिग्रहण गर्यो । पहिलाका हकदारले यस आदेशको विरुद्धमा सन् १९९६ मा मुद्दा हाले, र त्यो मामला महिनौंसम्म अदालतमा विचाराधीन रह्यो । भत्किएको भवन वर्षा र अन्य कारणले  दिनानुदिन अझै ध्वस्त हुँदै थियो र सन् १९९९ सम्म यही क्रम रह्यो । सन् २००१ मा पुरातत्त्व विभागको सहयोगमा केभिपिटिद्वारा ऐतिहासिक स्वरूप कायम गर्दै यसको पुनर्निर्माण गरियो । यसको पुनर्निर्माणसंबन्धी विस्तृत जानकारीका लागि केभिपिटिको सन् २००२ को प्रतिवेदनको पृ. ११ मा हेर्नुहोस् ।
references: REFERENCES KVPT & HMG DoA. 2002. Ayuguthi Sattal. Patan Darbar Square World Heritage Site, Final Report 2002. KVPT & HMG DoA. 1996. Ayuguthi Sattal. Patan Darbar Square, Ward 11. Historic Structure Report, January. Authored by Erich Theopile and Rohit Ranjitkar.

historical_events.event_description: "Before the coronation of the current king in 1975 and as part of the renovation of the adjacent Mani Ganesa Temple, the building's length was shortened approximately 6'-2" in the front and in the rear 6'-4"." (HSR Ayuguthi, p. 7)

Renovation under KVPT and DOA (see extensive reports from the KVPT). The HSR stated that funding came from the Andy Warhol Foundation, GTZ/UDLE, KVPT, and Mr Pandey and Mr Dickerman. Thi s was also part of the nationalisation process as the site was taken away from its occupants. The cost estimate mentioned in the HSR was US-$ 38,877.62 (KVPT Report HSR p A22)
